sources.description: The Denver Broncos have announced that they have re-signed wide receiver Lil’Jordan Humphrey to a one-year deal worth $1.3 million, which is the veteran minimum. The Broncos continue to re-sign depth players at vet minimum deals by bringing back veteran wide receiver and blocking specialist Lil’Jordan Humphrey on a one-year deal. He is a favorite […]
